title: Recording Sheet Cancel & Cleanup
requirements: Add a visible Cancel/Close Button to RecordingView in all states (recording, not-recording, finalizing): labeled 'Cancel' during recording and triggering onCancel; disabled during finalizing, re-enabled as 'Close' after pipeline completion
Add .onDisappear { onCancel() } fallback on RecordingView so external dismissal (window close, Escape) triggers onCancel when completedEntry is nil
If completedEntry is nil on dismiss and a partial .m4a file exists at tempURL, delete it via FileManager.removeItem (catch and log only — no orphaned .m4a files in ~/Documents)
Retain .interactiveDismissDisabled(isRecording || isFinalizing) for swipe-to-dismiss; after a failed start the sheet is closable via the Cancel button
acceptance_criteria: Closing the recording sheet at any state returns the app to a clean state: ListViewModel.isRecording is false afterwards
No orphan .m4a files remain in ~/Documents after a cancelled recording that had a partial file
A visible Cancel button is reachable during the recording state
out_of_scope: Save-vs-discard recovery on cancel (audio is deleted)
